caption: The video captures a green-lit indoor venue held in a steady frame, its flat middle-ground surface flanked by two standing silhouettes, one at left and one at right. Behind them a large rectangular screen glows with a dark reddish field scattered with white star-like points that flicker, fade, and reconfigure. To the right a staircase and diving-platform structure rises, while a wireframe sphere hangs at top center beneath rows of bright green lights. A soft green haze billows and thins in the upper-right corner, shifting shape and density over time. In the foreground a glass barrier with two vertical posts borders a pool or rink alive with continuously sparkling ripple patterns. The composition holds, and the figures remain standing at the sides, leaving the scene defined by ambient motion of light, haze, and shimmering surface.
relations: Green haze in the upper-right corner billows and thins, shifting shape and density over time.
White star-like points on the central screen flicker, fade, and reconfigure continuously.
The foreground pool surface maintains continuously sparkling ripple patterns.
Standing silhouettes and structural elements remain static within the steady frame.
